items.title: 阿联酋｜Al Sharqi Shipping启用7000万迪拉姆物流中心
items.title_en: UAE | Al Sharqi Shipping opens AED70m logistics centre
items.summary: Al Sharqi Shipping在迪拜工业城启用约7000万迪拉姆物流配送中心，提供约28万平方英尺仓储设施及20万平方英尺露天堆场和多温区服务。
items.summary_en: Al Sharqi Shipping opened an AED70m Dubai Industrial City distribution centre with about 280,000 sq ft of warehousing and 200,000 sq ft of open yard space and multi-temperature operations.
items.why_it_matters: 设施已运营，适合接洽仓储设备与运营合作，不属于新工程招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: The centre is operational rather than a new construction tender, offering opportunities in warehouse equipment and logistics partnerships.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注货架、叉车、冷链、物流自动化及仓储运营合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track racking, forklifts, cold-chain systems, warehouse automation and logistics partnerships.

items.title: 巴西｜5.859亿雷亚尔船舶建造及改造项目获融资批准
items.title_en: Brazil | R$585.9m financing approved for vessel builds and barge upgrades
items.summary: 巴西商船基金批准约5.859亿雷亚尔融资，支持LHG Logística新建3艘内河推船及改造206艘矿石运输驳船，由Juruá及Rio Maguari船厂参与。
items.summary_en: Brazil's Merchant Marine Fund approved about R$585.9m in financing for LHG Logística to build three river pushboats and retrofit 206 ore barges, involving Juruá and Rio Maguari shipyards.
items.why_it_matters: 融资获批并非全部设备订单已下达，后续船用设备采购值得跟踪。
items.why_it_matters_en: Financing approval signals potential supply-chain opportunities, although it does not mean all procurement is awarded.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注船用发动机、钢材、液压、船舶电气、舱盖和设备。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track marine engines, steel, hydraulics, vessel electrics, hatch covers and other components.
items.source_name: Brazil Ministry of Ports and Airports

items.title: 阿联酋｜Yas Island新建JW Marriott品牌住宅合作
items.title_en: UAE | JW Marriott Residences Yas Island development partnership announced
items.summary: TARAF与Steppe合作推进阿布扎比Yas Island的JW Marriott Residences项目，并与Marriott International达成品牌相关协议。尚未披露新的施工主合同金额。
items.summary_en: TARAF and Steppe announced a partnership to advance JW Marriott Residences Abu Dhabi, Yas Island, with a Marriott International branding agreement. No new main construction award amount was disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 高端住宅开发可形成精装和家具需求，但需核实实际项目采购阶段。
items.why_it_matters_en: A luxury residential project may support fit-out and furnishings demand subject to actual procurement timing.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注高端家具、卫浴、石材、照明、智能家居和精装修。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track high-end furniture, bathrooms, stone, lighting, smart homes and fit-out.

items.title: 巴西｜Itaqui港化肥码头拟投资1.47亿雷亚尔
items.title_en: Brazil | Itaqui fertiliser terminal planned investment of R$147m
items.summary: 巴西港口主管部门提出Itaqui港化肥码头租赁与升级计划，预计投资约1.47亿雷亚尔，目标提升化肥及散货处理能力；尚属拟议拍卖计划。
items.summary_en: Brazil's ports authority has outlined a planned lease and upgrade of an Itaqui fertiliser terminal, with anticipated investment of about R$147m to expand bulk fertiliser handling. It is a planned auction, not an awarded contract.
items.why_it_matters: 港口产业链的潜在增量机会，但需持续关注招标正式发布。
items.why_it_matters_en: A potential terminal investment pipeline; track publication of formal tender documents.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注散货输送设备、筒仓、除尘环保、港机与电气。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track bulk conveyors, silos, dust control, cargo handling and electrical systems.
items.source_name: Brazil Ministry of Ports and Airports

items.title: 葡萄牙｜阿尔加维铁路三座桥梁更换工程约1500万欧元
items.title_en: Portugal | Algarve railway three bridge replacements tender worth about €15m
items.summary: 葡萄牙基础设施公司发布Faro、Tavira及Almargem三座铁路活动桥更新工程招标，估价约1500万欧元，编号10020567，截止2026年11月10日。
items.summary_en: Infraestruturas de Portugal published a tender for replacing three railway movable bridges at Faro, Tavira and Almargem, estimated at €15m, tender ref 10020567, due 10 November 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 明确的铁路桥梁施工招标，须核查参与资格及设备技术要求。
items.why_it_matters_en: A defined rail bridge tender, subject to supplier qualification and technical specifications.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注桥梁钢结构、活动机构、轨道工程、土建及本地承包商。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track bridge steel, movable mechanisms, trackwork, civil works and local contractors.

items.title: 坦桑尼亚｜Simiyu及Songwe地区办公楼工程采购
items.title_en: Tanzania | Simiyu and Songwe regional office design and construction procurement
items.summary: 据公开采购汇总，坦桑尼亚LATRA为Simiyu与Songwe地区办公设施发布工程设计及施工相关采购信息，公告日约10月15日，显示10月23日为截止日。原始文件及分包范围须核实。
items.summary_en: Procurement listings indicate LATRA office-building design and construction packages in Simiyu and Songwe, with notices around 15 October and a stated 23 October deadline; verify original documents and scope.
items.why_it_matters: 属于公开采购线索，工程资质和合同结构尚待确认。
items.why_it_matters_en: These are procurement leads pending original tender documents and eligibility checks.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注建筑、门窗、办公家具、机电、空调和装修。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track building works, windows, office furniture, MEP, air conditioning and interior fit-out.

items.title: 摩洛哥｜多段乡村道路技术研究采购
items.title_en: Morocco | Rural roads technical study procurements
items.summary: 近期摩洛哥道路工程采购汇总包含若干乡村道路技术研究服务，所涉路段约7公里、8.5公里、4公里及4.5公里。当前为设计研究阶段，非道路施工主合同。
items.summary_en: Recent Moroccan procurement listings cover technical studies for rural road sections of about 7km, 8.5km, 4km and 4.5km; these are study procurements rather than construction awards.
items.why_it_matters: 可与本地工程咨询伙伴对接并关注后续施工阶段。
items.why_it_matters_en: Engage local engineering consultants and track subsequent works tenders.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注设计咨询合作，以及未来施工设备、路面材料和排水设施。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track engineering consultants and future equipment, paving materials and drainage works.

items.title: 阿尔及利亚｜水泥厂60kV变电站电气设备改造招标
items.title_en: Algeria | Cement plant 60kV substation electrical retrofit tender
items.summary: Hadjar-Soud水泥厂据采购公告拟采购5台高压断路器及数字化保护和自动化系统，范围涉及研究、供货、安装监督与调试；所列截止日为12月5日，须核验原始技术文件。
items.summary_en: Procurement listings indicate Hadjar-Soud cement plant seeks five high-voltage breakers and digital protection and automation equipment, with study, supply, installation supervision and commissioning. Reported deadline 5 December; check original specs.
items.why_it_matters: 设备采购范围具体，适合专业电力设备厂家评估技术符合性。
items.why_it_matters_en: A relatively focused equipment supply opportunity, subject to technical and qualification verification.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注高压断路器、继电保护、自动化和变电站改造。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track HV breakers, relay protection, automation and substation retrofits.
